item.title: Show HN: Go CLI for website health checks, zero dependencies
item.summary: A small CLI that runs the checks you'd normally do manually: DNS, HTTPS, SSL expiry, redirects, response time, email records, domain expiry, and more. Zero dependencies, JSON output, install via Homebrew. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49346733 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
